description: Data-layer foundation for yyyymm layout + global dedup. Split storage so the SHA-256 is known BEFORE a file is placed (read once): StageTemp streams to a .staging temp file and returns the hash; FinalizeStaged renames the staged file into photos/ or recyclebin/ under a <yyyymm> subdir with a collision-safe name. Extend the Postgres schema (is_trash, dup_of, non-unique sha256 index), the store.Photo struct, and all SELECT/scan/upsert sites, and add the lookup/trash/mutation methods later steps need. This feature is the dependency base for FEAT-002 and FEAT-003; it leaves the build green because new methods are simply unused until then (the only behavior change is ListAll/ListByDate gaining a WHERE is_trash=false filter, which is correct for the main grid).
steps: internal/storage/storage.go: add `type StageResult struct { TempRel string; Size int64; SHA256 string }`. Add `StageTemp(src io.Reader, expectedSize int64) (*StageResult, error)`: build a staging rel path `.staging/<random>.part` (use crypto/rand or time+rand for the name), safeJoin it, MkdirAll its dir, open O_CREATE|O_TRUNC|O_WRONLY 0644, stream via io.MultiWriter(f, sha256.New()), fsync, close, enforce expectedSize>=0 size check (remove temp + error on mismatch), and return StageResult{TempRel, Size, hex hash}. Do NOT rename. Mirror the error handling style already used in WriteAtomic (remove the temp file on every failure path).
internal/storage/storage.go: add `RemoveStaged(tempRel string) error` (safeJoin + os.Remove) for the caller's error path.
internal/storage/storage.go: add `yyyymmFromTime(t time.Time) string` returning t.Format("200601"), using time.Now() when t.IsZero().

internal/storage/storage.go: add `collisionSafeName(destDirAbs, baseName, fullHash string) (string, error)` — given an absolute target directory and a base filename like IMG_0001.HEIC: if the name is free return it; if a file with that exact name exists but has DIFFERENT content, return `<stem>_<fullHash[:8]><ext>`, then `<stem>_<fullHash[:12]><ext>` if that is also taken by different content; if an existing file has identical content, reuse that name (idempotent). Split stem/ext with path/filepath. Never overwrite a different file. Compare content cheaply by size first, then by hashing the existing file only when sizes match.

internal/storage/storage.go: add `FinalizeStaged(tempRel, destDir, baseName, fullHash string, mtime time.Time) (*Result, error)`: destDir is "photos" or "recyclebin"; compute yyyymm from mtime via yyyymmFromTime; build relDir `<destDir>/<yyyymm>`, safeJoin, MkdirAll; call collisionSafeName to pick the final file name; os.Rename the staged temp file (abs of tempRel) into the final abs path; os.Chtimes(mtime) when non-zero; return *Result{RelPath (ToSlash, from root), AbsPath, Size, SHA256:fullHash}. Keep WriteAtomic unchanged (chunk PUTs under .uploads/ still use it).
internal/storage/storage_test.go: add stdlib `testing` unit tests (see acceptance_criteria).

internal/store/postgres.go: in migrate(), after the existing CREATE TABLE/CREATE INDEX, append idempotent statements: `ALTER TABLE photos ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_trash BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;`, `ALTER TABLE photos ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS dup_of BIGINT;`, `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS photos_sha256_idx ON photos (sha256);` (NON-unique — dup and original share a hash). Do NOT add a UNIQUE constraint on sha256.
internal/store/postgres.go: add fields `IsTrash bool` and `DupOf *int64` to store.Photo.

internal/store/postgres.go: update UpsertPhoto INSERT column list to include is_trash, dup_of (and $ placeholders) and the ON CONFLICT (rel_path) DO UPDATE SET to also set is_trash=EXCLUDED.is_trash, dup_of=EXCLUDED.dup_of; pass ph.IsTrash, ph.DupOf.

internal/store/postgres.go: update the SELECT column lists AND the rows.Scan/QueryRow.Scan argument lists of GetByRelPath, ListByDate, ListAll to include is_trash, dup_of (scan into &ph.IsTrash, &ph.DupOf). Add `AND is_trash = false` to ListByDate's WHERE and `WHERE is_trash = false` to ListAll so the main dashboard grid excludes trash.

internal/store/postgres.go: add GetBySHA256(ctx, hash string) (*Photo, error) — SELECT ... WHERE sha256=$1 ORDER BY uploaded_at ASC LIMIT 1 (the original, created first); pgx.ErrNoRows -> nil,nil; nil-safe when !enabled().
internal/store/postgres.go: add ListTrash(ctx, limit int) ([]Photo, error) — WHERE is_trash = true ORDER BY taken_at DESC LIMIT $1; same column list/scan.

internal/store/postgres.go: add GetByID(ctx, id int64) (*Photo, error) (for resolving dup_of -> original name in the trash view), DeletePhotoByID(ctx, id int64) error, DeletePhotoByRelPath(ctx, rel string) error, and SetTrashState(ctx, oldRelPath, newRelPath string, isTrash bool, dupOf *int64) error that updates rel_path, is_trash and dup_of for the restored row. All nil-safe via p.enabled().
acceptance_criteria: go build ./... and go vet ./... both pass from the worktree root.

go test ./internal/storage/... passes with new tests covering: StageTemp returns the correct SHA-256 (matches crypto/sha256 of the input) and Size, and leaves a file under .staging/; FinalizeStaged places bytes at photos/<yyyymm>/<base>.ext derived from the given mtime; finalizing DIFFERENT bytes to the same base name produces <stem>_<hash8><ext> without overwriting the first file; finalizing identical bytes to the same base is idempotent (no second file); a base name attempting path traversal is rejected or sanitised by safeJoin.

store.Photo has IsTrash bool and DupOf *int64; ListAll/ListByDate only return is_trash=false rows; GetBySHA256, ListTrash, GetByID, DeletePhotoByID, DeletePhotoByRelPath, SetTrashState exist and compile.
findings:
STORAGE SIGNATURES (internal/storage/storage.go):
- type StageResult struct { TempRel string; Size int64; SHA256 string } // SHA256 is lowercase hex
- (s *Storage) StageTemp(src io.Reader, expectedSize int64) (*StageResult, error) — streams to .staging/<32hex>.part, hashes once, fsyncs, NO rename. Pass expectedSize=-1 to skip the size check (e.g. chunked assembly where size is already known on disk). On any error the temp file is removed.
- (s *Storage) RemoveStaged(tempRel string) error — safeJoin + os.Remove; call on the caller's error path if you staged but won't finalize.
- (s *Storage) FinalizeStaged(tempRel, destDir, baseName, fullHash string, mtime time.Time) (*Result, error) — destDir MUST be "photos" or "recyclebin" (a top-level dir name; it becomes <destDir>/<yyyymm>/<name>). yyyymm derived from mtime (time.Now() when mtime.IsZero()). Returns *Result{RelPath (ToSlash, from root, e.g. "photos/202303/IMG_0001.HEIC"), AbsPath, Size (re-stat'd), SHA256: fullHash}.
- WriteAtomic is UNCHANGED — chunk PUTs under .uploads/ still use it.

COLLISION-NAMING RULE (collisionSafeName, used inside FinalizeStaged): given baseName like IMG_0001.HEIC, tries in order: [baseName, <stem>_<hash8><ext>, <stem>_<hash12><ext>] where hash8/hash12 are fullHash[:8]/[:12]. First candidate whose name is free is used. If a candidate exists with IDENTICAL content (size then sha256 compare) that name is reused (idempotent) and the staged temp is removed instead of renamed. A different file is NEVER overwritten. stem/ext split via filepath.Ext. safeJoin guards every destination.

DEDUP FLOW FOR FEAT-002/003: StageTemp first, then pg.GetBySHA256(ctx, stageRes.SHA256). If it returns a non-nil original -> this upload is a global duplicate: FinalizeStaged into "recyclebin", set store.Photo.IsTrash=true and DupOf=&original.ID. Else FinalizeStaged into "photos" with IsTrash=false, DupOf=nil. baseName should be the original request filename (from destRelFromHeader). taken_at/mtime comes from parseOCMtime(X-OC-Mtime).

STORE (internal/store/postgres.go):
- Photo gained: IsTrash bool, DupOf *int64.
- Schema: added via idempotent ALTERs in migrate() — is_trash BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, dup_of BIGINT, plus NON-unique photos_sha256_idx. No UNIQUE on sha256.
- UpsertPhoto now writes/updates is_trash & dup_of.
- GetByRelPath/ListByDate/ListAll scan the two new cols. ListByDate & ListAll now filter is_trash=false (main grid excludes trash).
- New methods (all nil-safe via enabled(), pgx.ErrNoRows -> nil,nil): GetBySHA256(ctx,hash) *Photo (earliest by uploaded_at ASC = the original), ListTrash(ctx,limit) []Photo (is_trash=true, taken_at DESC), GetByID(ctx,id) *Photo, DeletePhotoByID(ctx,id), DeletePhotoByRelPath(ctx,rel), SetTrashState(ctx,oldRelPath,newRelPath,isTrash,dupOf) — updates rel_path,is_trash,dup_of on the row matched by oldRelPath (used for restore from trash).

VERIFIED: go build ./... + go vet ./... pass; go test ./internal/storage/... passes (6 tests).
